references.query: For a Contoso employee in India, can a line manager provide an official employment reference under the Global handbook?
references.ground_truth: The Global handbook says only HR provides official employment references. A line manager should direct the request to HR rather than issue the official reference.

passages.quote:
This fictional policy is created solely for testing an HR knowledge assistant. It is not legal advice and must not
be used as an actual employment policy.
Only HR provides official employment references.

checks.response: No. Under the Global handbook, only HR provides official employment references. Your line manager should direct the request to HR.
checks.reason: Preserves the Global scope and HR-only authorization, without requiring an unrequested demo disclaimer.

checks.response: Yes. Under the Global handbook, your line manager can issue an official employment reference directly without involving HR.
checks.reason: Directly contradicts the source's HR-only authorization.

references.query: Under our Hong Kong policy, does the two-day remote-work allowance let me work outside Hong Kong without advance review?
references.ground_truth: No. Eligible roles may work remotely up to two days per week subject to team and customer needs. Working outside Hong Kong separately requires prior tax, immigration, security and data-privacy assessment.

passages.quote:
本文件只供測試「Ask HR」知識助理使用,內容屬虛構示範,並非法律意見或正式僱傭政策。香港法例、適用
的僱傭合約及正式公司規則如有不同,均以該等文件為準。
合資格職位每週可遙距工作最多兩天,須配合團隊及客戶需要。
在香港以外遙距工作須預先通過稅務、移民、保安及資料私隱評估。

checks.response: No. Our Hong Kong policy permits eligible roles to work remotely up to two days per week, subject to team and customer needs. Working outside Hong Kong still requires prior tax, immigration, security and data-privacy assessments.
checks.reason: Separates the conditional weekly allowance from the additional cross-border approval requirement.

checks.response: Yes. Our Hong Kong policy permits eligible roles to work remotely up to two days per week, subject to team and customer needs. Within that allowance you can work anywhere outside Hong Kong without advance assessment.
checks.reason: Invents an exemption from the explicit prior cross-border assessments.

references.query: Under our Hong Kong policy, does exactly 60 days of continuous employment meet the general MPF service-length threshold?
references.ground_truth: Yes. The general service-length threshold is 60 days or more, so exactly 60 days meets that threshold. The policy's age range, exemptions and industry-specific rules still apply; this does not establish that every employee must enroll on that exact day.

業特別規則另行核實。

checks.response: Yes. Our Hong Kong policy's general service-length threshold is 60 days or more, so exactly 60 days meets it. The age range, exemptions and industry-specific rules still need to be considered; enrollment follows the applicable statutory timeframe.
checks.reason: Preserves the explicit inclusive 60-day threshold and its conditions.

checks.response: No. Our Hong Kong policy requires strictly more than 60 days of continuous employment; exactly 60 days is excluded from the general service-length threshold.
checks.reason: Changes the explicit 60-days-or-more service threshold to an exclusive one.

references.query: Under the Global handbook, may an employee in India upload confidential employee data to an unapproved AI tool if a human will review the result?
references.ground_truth: No. The Global handbook prohibits uploading confidential employee or customer data to unapproved AI tools. A planned human review does not create an exception to that restriction.

passages.quote:
· Do not upload confidential employee or customer data into unapproved Al tools.

· Al-assisted employment decisions require meaningful human review and documented fairness checks.

checks.response: No. The Global handbook prohibits uploading confidential employee or customer data to unapproved AI tools. Having a human review the result does not waive that restriction.
checks.reason: Preserves the Global prohibition and does not invent an exception for human review.

checks.response: Yes. The Global handbook permits uploading confidential employee data to any AI tool as long as a human reviews the result.
checks.reason: Invents an exception to the explicit prohibition on unapproved tools.
